description: This file contains CMake functions for converting JSON strings to CMake-compatible strings, including escaping special characters and removing quotation marks.

methods.name: json_string_to_cmake
methods.description: Converts a JSON-formatted string into a CMake string with proper escaping and formatting.

methods.name: json_string_ref_to_cmake
methods.description: References a JSON string via a variable name and converts it into a CMake string using json_string_to_cmake.
